notes.title: Release pushed back, our apologies
notes.notes:
Due to certain circumstances I will have to push back the release by 6 months or so, I have been working hard on really polishing the mechanics for the game, implementing new features, re-working and building new play areas and many other things. While everything is coming together I ask that you please have patience and understand I am only one person, I am working on it! ^_^

In the meantime I have a lot of updates that I will be announcing soon so look forward to those, progression continues!

Thanks again for your patience and support of Alone Without Her.

notes.title: Title Screen Update #4 | Store, Logo & In-Game Purchases
notes.notes:
Title Screen Update #4 *WIP*

I wanted to make it so the player can have an interactive and AWH stylized store/checkout system for purchasing episodes in game. Of course you will still be able to purchase episodes directly from steam but this will offer a more immersive experience.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=djhHe1l_3n4

Updates:
- Logo added
- FX added to logo
- Store menu Added
- Episode presentation added
- Episode purchase confirmation added
- Purchase prices set
- In game purchases *WIP*
- Launch Config Box Image Added
